title: Mark current and planned architecture documentation
correctionCommitMessage: docs: mark current architecture document state
rootCause: Add explicit current/planned/supersession markers so implemented capability is distinguishable from roadmap intent.

finding.semanticClaim: Several architecture documents mix current-state and planned-state descriptions without an explicit supersession marker, making repository boundaries and implemented capability difficult to determine.

authorityClassification: MISSING_ARCHITECTURE_STATE with DOCUMENT_STALE claims; production architecture is current and documentation was ambiguous/stale

contradictedClaims.canonicalFact: The repository contains implemented workflow, reviewer, execution, validation, and evidence infrastructure in addition to the Factory foundation.
contradictedClaims.canonicalFactOwner: Current production source under src/agents/, src/orchestration/, and src/runtime/; typed contracts remain authoritative.
contradictedClaims.after: The current product boundary names the implemented Factory infrastructure and keeps complete customer-project generation planned.

contradictedClaims.before: Future Reviewer agents, once implemented, will belong under src/agents/; no reviewer directories are created in this phase.
contradictedClaims.canonicalFact: Five read-only reviewer implementations already exist under src/agents/reviewers/ and are represented in the nine-definition catalog.
contradictedClaims.canonicalFactOwner: src/agents/catalog.ts plus the existing src/agents/reviewers/<role>/ source tree.
contradictedClaims.after: The current tree lists the five reviewer directories and the placement rule describes the current nine-agent catalog.

contradictedClaims.before: Current implementation notes and future milestones were interleaved without a document-level state convention.
contradictedClaims.canonicalFact: Current Factory foundations and planned/deferred customer capabilities are distinct states.
contradictedClaims.canonicalFactOwner: The implemented production modules and typed contracts; the roadmap is a descriptive projection only.

contradictedClaims.before: The document described current agent architecture but did not explicitly identify its current/non-runtime role.
contradictedClaims.canonicalFact: The typed catalog and domain/runtime validators enforce current agent identity, capability, tool, and skill-assignment behavior.
contradictedClaims.after: The document is explicitly CURRENT_ARCHITECTURE and states that Markdown is descriptive, not runtime authority.
